lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 450 File Number Complaint No. 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Oohh. So you had to move it from behind the garage to behind the house. Did he say why? Did you know why?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did he tell you those clothes came from?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You kinda knew better though, don't ya?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You now know better, they were girl clothes, weren't they?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Were they in a bag or anything?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: ... pants and shirt and anything else you saw... Had blood on the shirt?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where on the shirt was the blood? Where on the shirt was the blood?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was it a button down shirt?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Remember what kind of pants were they blue jean pants or...

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else did he get out of the garage? Be honest OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did he do with the shovel?
